definitions.explanation: To pour liquid into a container, especially drinks.

notes:
{注|つ}ぐ means to pour liquid, especially drinks, into a container.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Takes を particle: お{茶|ちゃ}を{注|つ}ぐ

COMMON PATTERNS:
- お{茶|ちゃ}を{注|つ}ぐ: to pour tea
- コーヒーを{注|つ}ぐ: to pour coffee
- グラスに{注|つ}ぐ: to pour into a glass
- お{酒|さけ}を{注|つ}いであげる: to pour sake for someone

ALTERNATE READING:
{注|そそ}ぐ is an alternate reading with similar meaning but also extends to "pouring" attention or effort.

HOMOPHONE DISTINCTION:
- {注|つ}ぐ: to pour (liquids)
- {継|つ}ぐ: to succeed, inherit
- {次|つ}ぐ: to rank next to
